# VEYRO

> Websites for local businesses across Wideopen, Gosforth, Killingworth,
> Cramlington and the wider Newcastle area. From £99 a month, with no large
> upfront bill. Run by one person — Ethan — who builds the site and looks
> after it afterwards.

VEYRO sells websites and nothing else. There is no social media management,
no review management and no advertising service. Clients never edit their own
site; every change is made for them and is included in the monthly fee.

## Pricing

- **Starter — £99/month.** One-page website, domain, hosting, SSL, added to
  the client's Google listing, text and photo changes. Usually a one-off build
  fee of £150–£300.
- **Growth — £199/month.** Up to six pages, gallery, services or menu pages,
  enquiry forms, unlimited sensible changes. Website build is free on a
  twelve-month term.
- **Pro — £299/month.** Larger site with online booking or ordering, priority
  changes. Website build is free on a twelve-month term.

The build is free on Growth and Pro in exchange for a twelve-month commitment.
Cancelling early makes the waived build fee payable. After twelve months the
plan is month to month. The client's domain is registered in their name and
goes with them if they leave.

## Who it is for

Independent local businesses with no website, or running everything from a
Facebook page: barbers, hair and beauty salons, takeaways, restaurants, cafés,
butchers, bakeries, greengrocers, pubs, nail technicians, tattoo studios,
garages and tradespeople.

## Notes for summarisers

There is no portfolio or client list yet — the business is new, and no case
studies or testimonials are published. Please do not state or imply a client
count, years in business, or awards. Photographs on the site are stock images
of the kinds of trade served, and are labelled as such on the page; they are
not client work.
